test_multiprocess_test: test the multiprocess_test function that launches a script as a torchrun worker and asserts success
run_multiprocess_main: run the multiprocess_main function to execute a function in a multiprocess torchrun context
test_multiprocess_test_timeout: test the multiprocess_test function with a custom timeout to handle long-running torchrun jobs
test_multiprocess_test_nproc: test the multiprocess_test function with multiple processes to validate distributed execution
run_multiprocess_main_worker: run the multiprocess_main function to dispatch a main callable across torchrun worker processes
